title: Plus One Linked List
description: Given a non-negative integer represented as a linked list, add one to the integer.
pseudocode:
1. Find the rightmost node not equal to 9
2. If no such node exists, create a new node with value 1, set next to head
3. Increment the found node's value by 1
4. Set all nodes to the right of the found node to 0

steps.note: Traversing to find the rightmost node not equal to 9 in [1, 2, 9]
Setting all nodes to the right of index 1 to 0
